setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 loops 8 steps at 90 BPM on the example MIDI device and is set to Foundation. Pattern 1 (C, D, E, F on steps 1 to 4, velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) is the Anchor; pattern 2 (a C at velocity 100 on steps 5 and 7) offers additions. Both patterns are assigned, Add amount is 100 and Add accent is 70. The norns shows the Rhythm page and the grid lights steps 1 to 5 and 7.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Channel (3,8), turn E1 to Channel tasks, E2 to Merge modes and press K3. Strategy reads FOUNDATION: Foundation, not the saved trig merge, is choosing this channel's trigs.
steps.title: Open Merge modes

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Active. Strategy and Active both read FOUNDATION and Pending reads NONE. The Strategy key (14,8) glows at its brightest, the sign that Foundation is in charge: the four anchors on steps 1 to 4 plus additions on steps 5 and 7.
steps.title: Foundation decides the trigs

steps.caption: Tap Play, let two loops run, then tap Stop. You hear C D E F (60, 62, 64, 65) followed by the additions, a C on steps 5 and 7. Look at the strip below: the additions are quieter, velocity 70, because Add accent 70 scales pattern 2's velocity of 100.
steps.title: Hear Foundation

steps.caption: Reopen Merge modes, select Strategy and turn E3 to ALL. Strategy and Active read ALL and the Strategy key (14,8) dims: the saved trig merge is deciding again, with every trig of both patterns.
steps.title: Switch the Strategy to All

steps.caption: Tap Play, let two loops run, then tap Stop. The same notes sound, but the additions on steps 5 and 7 now keep pattern 2's own velocity, 100, so they are louder than Foundation's 70 in the strip below.
steps.title: Hear All

steps.caption: Reopen Merge modes, select Strategy and turn E3 to SKIP. The footer reads SKIP APPLIED, Strategy and Active read SKIP and the Strategy key (14,8) dims further. Skip, Only and All hand the trigs back to the saved legacy merge; Foundation's protection and accent no longer apply.
steps.title: Return to Skip

title: Foundation and All: who decides the trigs
